//Features from Lua 5.2 that are unlikely to break existing code
// are enabled by default. Some other features that *might* break
// some existing code (e.g. __pairs or os.execute() return values)
// can be enabled here. Note: this does not provide full compatibility
// with Lua 5.2 at this time

//This is the client for the GDB JIT API. GDB 7.0 or higher is
// required to make use of it. See lj_gdbjit.c for details. Enabling
// this causes a non-negligible overhead, even when not running
// under GDB
LUAJIT_USE_GDBJIT:BOOL=OFF

//Use the system provided memory allocator (realloc) instead of
// the bundled memory allocator. This is slower, but sometimes
// helpful for debugging. It's helpful for Valgrind's memcheck
// tool, too. This option cannot be enabled on x64, since the built-in
// allocator is mandatory
